question: Who does not depart from yoking, and what did our teacher say about initiation as enjoyment-means?
premises: to be yoked, not departing, therefore thus in Malini doctrine
stating enjoyment-means-ness of initiation, our teacher said
inference: Undeparting yoking holds; the teacher states initiation as enjoyment-means.
uncertainties: no read as emphatic particle per gloss
plain_english: To be yoked, not departing — therefore thus, in glorious Malini doctrine; stating enjoyment-etc. means-ness of initiation, our teacher said.
